name: AudioOut2 channel layout: 12-channel 0x2d63f10c -> 8-channel 0x63f108
tells_game: a module that creates AudioOut2 ports asks for the 8-channel layout wherever it would load the 12-channel code; the layout code's low byte is the channel count, which sizes the buffer and selects the PortCreate request (0xc00 vs 0x800)
prior_art: firmware: through 6.50 sceAudioOut2PortCreate accepts port types {1,2,8} only, so a 12-channel request fails with 0x8026800e; from 7.01 type 12 needs the opt-in export aFxSMCVm5mQ (7.01+) to have run, and from 8.00 through 13.60 init enables it on its own when the process's compiled PS5 SDK word is 0x08000000 or newer (12.60 not checked); the build caps the SDK word at the tier stamp (7xx: 0x07000038), so a 7xx build gets no automatic enable on any console firmware, 8.00 and later included; hardware: Halo PPSA28038 on 7.61 has no audio until the code selecting this layout loads the 8-channel code, rest of the build held constant; the Deckerr97 registry records the same 12-to-8 mapping at 4.50 for several titles as title-local edits (Rune Factory, NHL 26, Yooka-Replaylee); not measured: hardware at 8.00 and later with this rule, 7.01 through 7.60, 1.00 through 5.50
